elements.label: About
elements.value: Controls whether the character faces the camera or the movement direction, and whether direction is locked on start.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/strafe_rotation.schema.json, set sr_c_strafe to {{sr_c_strafe}}]
Set MovementAbility.strafeMode to {{sr_c_strafe}}. On = character faces camera forward instead of movement direction.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/strafe_rotation.schema.json, set sr_c_dir_lock to {{sr_c_dir_lock}}]
Set MovementAbility.slideDirectionLockEnabled to {{sr_c_dir_lock}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/strafe_rotation.schema.json, set sr_t_rotation to {{sr_t_rotation}}]
Set MovementAbility.rotationSpeed to {{sr_t_rotation}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/strafe_rotation.schema.json, set sr_t_lock_threshold to {{sr_t_lock_threshold}}]
Set MovementAbility.slideDirectionLockThreshold to {{sr_t_lock_threshold}}. Input magnitude required before direction locks.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/strafe_rotation.schema.json, set sr_t_speed to {{sr_t_speed}}]
Set MovementAbility.moveSpeed to {{sr_t_speed}}.
